id: 22_Fire safety Safety measures in microbiology labs part3 laboratory microbiologyla
title: 微生物实验室的消防安全
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/22_Fire safety Safety measures in microbiology labs part3 laboratory microbiologyla.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/22_Fire safety Safety measures in microbiology labs part3 laboratory microbiologyla/src.py

points.K3: 安全出口：畅通、标识清楚
points.S1: 发现火情：喊人、报警、报告
points.S4: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚

shots.scene: 欣欣站在走廊的灭火器箱旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fire extinguisher cabinet in a lab corridor and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲微生物实验室的消防安全。
overlay: 微生物实验室的消防安全

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现灭火器、安全出口、易燃品柜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three floating icons: a fire extinguisher, an emergency exit sign and a flammable storage cabinet.
shots.narration: 灭火器、安全出口、易燃品和明火。

shots.scene: 阿杰在台面上用酒精灯接种，旁边放着乙醇瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student inoculates a culture with a lit alcohol lamp on the bench, an ethanol spray bottle standing close by.
shots.narration: 阿杰点着酒精灯接种，乙醇瓶就在旁边。

shots.scene: 阿杰起身去接电话，酒精灯还燃着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks away to answer his phone while the alcohol lamp is still burning on the bench.
shots.narration: 他起身接电话，灯还燃着。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，用灯帽盖灭酒精灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and puts out the alcohol lamp by covering it with its cap.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧用灯帽把它盖灭。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前严肃地点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods seriously in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 微生物实验室，火源和燃料都不少。

shots.scene: 走廊墙边的灭火器箱，前面没有遮挡
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher cabinet on a corridor wall with nothing blocking it. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器要放在显眼、好拿的地方，

shots.scene: 灭火器前堆着纸箱被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher hidden behind stacked boxes, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 不能被杂物挡住。

shots.scene: 老李查看灭火器压力表和检查卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the pressure gauge of a fire extinguisher and signs a blank inspection tag.
shots.narration: 还要定期检查维护，

shots.scene: 压力表指针在绿区，旁边有日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a pressure gauge with the needle in the green zone, a calendar icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 看压力是否正常、是否在有效期内。

shots.scene: 王老师在空地上组织灭火器培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a fire extinguisher training session outdoors with several students, including the young male student.
shots.narration: 灭火器要人人会用，事先培训。

shots.scene: 四步图示：提起、拔销、握管、压把
shots.prompt_en: A four-step diagram: lift the extinguisher, pull the pin, hold the hose, press the handle. No people.
shots.narration: 要领四个字：提、拔、握、压。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在上风处，对准训练用火盆的火焰根部喷射
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands upwind and aims the extinguisher at the base of flames in a training fire pan.
shots.narration: 站在上风处，对准火焰根部。

shots.section_title: 安全出口：畅通、标识清楚
shots.scene: 实验室门口上方的绿色安全出口标志亮着
shots.prompt_en: A green emergency exit sign glows above a lab corridor door. No people.
shots.narration: 安全出口要保持畅通，
overlay: 安全出口：畅通、标识清楚

shots.section_title: 安全出口：畅通、标识清楚
shots.scene: 出口门前堆着仪器纸箱被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An exit door blocked by equipment boxes, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 门口不堆东西，门不上锁。

shots.section_title: 安全出口：畅通、标识清楚
shots.scene: 走廊地面上的疏散指示箭头亮着
shots.prompt_en: Evacuation direction arrows glow along the corridor floor and wall. No people.
shots.narration: 出口标志、疏散指示要清楚。

shots.scene: 老李沿着疏散路线巡查
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks along the evacuation route with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 疏散路线，要定期检查，

shots.scene: 楼层平面图上标出两条疏散路线
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with two evacuation routes highlighted toward two exits. No people.
shots.narration: 确认一路畅通，没有阻挡。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在门口的疏散图前看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student studies an evacuation map near the lab door.
shots.narration: 进实验室，先看清最近的出口。

shots.scene: 黄色易燃品储存柜，门上有火焰象形图
shots.prompt_en: A yellow flammable storage cabinet with a flame pictogram on its door. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃物品，要放进指定的易燃品柜。

shots.scene: 小研把乙醇大瓶放进易燃品柜，关好门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts a large ethanol bottle into the flammable storage cabinet and closes the door.
shots.narration: 乙醇、有机溶剂用完放回去，

shots.scene: 台面上只留一小瓶乙醇，远处是酒精灯
shots.prompt_en: Only a small ethanol bottle stays on the bench, placed far from an unlit alcohol lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 台面上只留当天够用的少量。

shots.scene: 电热接种环灭菌器图标打勾，旁边酒精灯
shots.prompt_en: An electric loop sterilizer icon with a green check, beside an alcohol lamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 明火能少用就少用，

shots.scene: 用一盏酒精灯去点另一盏被打叉
shots.prompt_en: One alcohol lamp being used to light another, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 不用一盏灯去点另一盏。

shots.scene: 灯帽盖在酒精灯上，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A cap placed over an alcohol lamp, the flame going out. No people.
shots.narration: 用完用灯帽盖灭，不用嘴吹。

shots.scene: 燃着的酒精灯旁无人，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A burning alcohol lamp on an empty bench with nobody around, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 点着的火，人不能离开。

shots.section_title: 发现火情：喊人、报警、报告
shots.scene: 实验台一角冒起火苗和烟
shots.prompt_en: Small flames and smoke rise from one corner of a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 万一发现着火，
overlay: 发现火情：喊人、报警、报告

shots.section_title: 发现火情：喊人、报警、报告
shots.scene: 小研大声呼喊，按下墙上的手动报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shouts a warning and presses a manual fire alarm button on the wall.
shots.narration: 先大声喊人，按下报警按钮。

shots.section_title: 发现火情：喊人、报警、报告
shots.scene: 电话图标显示 119
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon showing the number 119. No people.
shots.narration: 拨打 119，说清地点和燃烧物。

shots.section_title: 发现火情：喊人、报警、报告
shots.scene: 报告链：老周、学院、保卫处
shots.prompt_en: A reporting chain diagram: the older man icon, a college building icon, and the security officer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 同时报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 几种灭火器并排，各带不同图标
shots.prompt_en: Several fire extinguishers side by side, each with a different simple icon. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器有不同类型，要选对。

shots.scene: 木头纸张、液体、气体、金属、电器、油锅六个图标
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a row: wood and paper, a liquid, a gas cylinder, metal, an electrical plug and a cooking pan. No people.
shots.narration: 我国把火灾分成 A 到 F 几类。

shots.scene: 带电仪器起火，水桶图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A smoking electrical instrument with a crossed-out water bucket icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备着火，先断电，别泼水。

shots.scene: 小研指着灭火器上的适用图标给阿杰看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points to the suitability icons on a fire extinguisher while the young male student looks on.
shots.narration: 看清灭火器上的适用范围再用。

shots.scene: 台面上一小团火，小研用灭火毯盖住
shots.prompt_en: A small fire on a bench is smothered by the female graduate student with a fire blanket.
shots.narration: 初起的小火，有把握才扑救。

shots.scene: 火势变大，浓烟弥漫
shots.prompt_en: Flames spread and thick smoke fills the room. No people.
shots.narration: 火大了、烟浓了，马上撤离。

shots.scene: 学生们弯腰低姿、捂住口鼻沿疏散指示撤离
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student crouch low, cover their mouths and noses with wet cloths, and follow evacuation arrows.
shots.narration: 低姿前进，湿毛巾捂住口鼻。

shots.scene: 电梯图标打叉，楼梯图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An elevator icon crossed out in red and a staircase icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 走楼梯，不坐电梯，随手关门。

shots.scene: 大家在楼外集合点清点人数
shots.prompt_en: Students gather at an outdoor assembly point while the older man counts heads.
shots.narration: 到集合点清点人数，不返回取物。

shots.section_title: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚
shots.scene: 实验服袖口着火的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab coat sleeve catching fire. No people.
shots.narration: 身上衣服着了火，
overlay: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚

shots.section_title: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚
shots.scene: 奔跑的人形图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A running person outline with flames, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别跑，跑起来火更大。

shots.section_title: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚
shots.scene: 人形图标倒地翻滚，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A person outline dropping to the floor and rolling, the flames going out. No people.
shots.narration: 就地倒下，翻滚压灭火焰。

shots.section_title: 身上着火：别跑，就地打滚
shots.scene: 紧急喷淋和灭火毯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an emergency shower and a fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 附近有喷淋或灭火毯，也可以用。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在灭火器和安全出口标志之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a fire extinguisher and a glowing emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.scene: 灭火器和检查卡图标
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher icon with an inspection tag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器好拿、常查，人人会用。

shots.scene: 安全出口和疏散路线图标
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign icon and an evacuation route icon. No people.
shots.narration: 出口畅通，路线常检查。

shots.scene: 易燃品柜和盖上灯帽的酒精灯
shots.prompt_en: A flammable storage cabinet icon and a capped alcohol lamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃品进柜，明火少用不离人。

shots.scene: 电话 119 和撤离箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon showing 119 and an evacuation arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 着火喊人报警，大火快撤。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在安全出口标志下挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye under a glowing emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 防火在平时，下次见！
